text:
maya: Heads-up  we're launching the 'Sprinter Series' teaser next Wed 11am PT. Need X + LinkedIn threads, A/B caption tests, partner kit, and a 48h engagement playbook. Who owns scheduling + first responses? cc @jin @rohit

jin: I can run X schedule + replies 024h. Plan: 3 microthreads (announce, stat clip, CTA) + 1 follow-up next-day. Need hero 1200x675, 1:1 clip, and 15s vertical.

rohit: I'll own LinkedIn thread and partner outreach. Want the benchmark narrative condensed to two lines: latency SLO and customer cost delta. Also we should prepare a long-form LI variant for partners with a one-line quote.

tess: Assets list from me: hero JPG 1200x675, square 1080 PNG, 30s MP4 (with stat overlay), 15s vertical, 5 caption variants (X short, X long, LI short, LI long, partner plain-text), alt text, and CTA overlay with RSVP link.

sam: What's the registration URL? Social bot, drop the canonical link w/ utms.

social-bot: Registration created -> https://redwood.ai/events/sprinter-series?utm_campaign=sprinter_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_source=twitter (for twitter). Replace source=linkedin for LinkedIn.

jin: X cadence suggestion: Day0 11:00am PT (announce + hero), Day0 2:30pm PT (30s clip + stat), Day0 5:00pm PT (partner reshares), Day1 09:00am PT (reminder). Pin FAQ reply with timezone conversions.

rohit: LI plan: single threaded post (2 paragraphs) + short partner-ready one-liner. Draft: "Sprinter Series: predictable inference latency + measurable unit-cost savings. Join our live demo + benchmark deep-dive. Register: [link]" I'll tighten this in the doc.

maya: Approve stat: "~30% token cost reduction on KV-heavy workloads"? Legal ok?

social-bot: legal-bot: Approved conditional on 'internal benchmark' attribution. Backup copy without stat available.

tess: I'll render clip with overlay stat + CTA by Tue EOD and export a 15s vertical. Will also upload all alt text + captions to Drive.

maya: Owners for first responses: X 0-24h = jin (replies) + comms volunteers 24-48h; LI 0-24h = rohit (thread replies) + sam for product Qs. Route any "demo" mentions to #ae-inbound.

jin: Quick A/B test idea for X CTAs: Variant A: "Register" (direct) vs Variant B: "Save your seat" (softer). We'll measure CTR and signup rate in first 48h. Need UTMs for both.

rohit: Partner kit will include plain-text copy (no links), hero PNG, 15s clip, reshare caption, and partner handle list. I'll send to partners Mon AM.

tess: Social asset deadline: upload finals to #marketing-assets by 2026-04-06T20:00Z.

sam: I'll draft canned replies for top 12 FAQs and add them to the doc. Also put a pinned comment on X with the webinar time + agenda to reduce repetitive replies.

maya: Playbook: 1) collect top 15 replies, 2) tag and route demo prospects to AE, 3) DM top 5 engaged handles with scheduling link, 4) compile engagement recap after 48h (CTR, signups, partner reshares).

jin: One more  can we run a small influencer seed to 4 contacts? Rohit, can you approve the seed list?

rohit: Yes, approve 4 micro-influencers + 6 partners. Use partner copy for their reshares.

maya: Great  final checklist: assets, captions (A/B), UTMs, schedule, owners, partner kit, engagement playbook. If no gaps I'll mark as ready and we can move to asset signoff. :rocket:
